author: iDiamondPorkchop
body:
You get completely black leather armor but the helmet is your team's color.
You get a wooden sword and 5 shurikens, which will be nether stars that can be thrown for 1 1/2 hearts of damage.
You get a a piece of black wool and when right-clicked, you get invisibility and speed II  for 20 seconds. 60 second cooldown.
If it's too op tell me in the comments and I will make changes.
Edit: Full black leather armor!
You're a ninja :P
Edit: Speed and Invisibility for 10 seconds.
Edit: Shurikens do 1  heart of damage
Edit: Unbreaking II sharp 1 sword
